title: JRC GloFAS modeled river flood depth, 100-year return-period scenario (modelled context)
publisher: Copernicus Emergency Management Service; European Commission Joint Research Centre (JRC)
publication_date: Dataset version 2.1.2; README updated 2026-01-12; source directory lists these two tiles modified 2025-12-18
license: Reusable with attribution. The dataset README states Open Data Commons Open Database License v1.0 (ODbL 1.0); the linked JRC copyright notice states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). This project applies the stricter ODbL 1.0 terms (attribution and share-alike for derived databases) as the defensible common basis.

license_resolution.rationale: Both source statements permit reuse with attribution. The dataset README is the dataset-specific statement; its ODbL 1.0 terms are at least as strict as CC BY 4.0, so applying ODbL 1.0 satisfies the attribution requirement common to both and adds share-alike for derived databases.

units: Modeled flood water depth in metres; raw band values; -9999 is NoData
geographic_coverage: Two source grid tiles ID185 N20_E70 and ID186 N10_E70; city preview clipped to the bounding rectangle of the existing provisional Kochi boundary. This is a rendering crop only and is not used as a validated coverage mask.

permanent_water_files.purpose: Exclude JRC-patched permanent water from the modelled flood-depth screening.

processing.rendering: transparent blue overlay for positive modeled depth; transparent for zero, NoData, and outside source coverage

limitations: Global modeled riverine inundation scenario product, not an observation, forecast, official warning, site-specific engineering result, or proof of damage.
90 m nominal resolution; land areas only; model artifacts are documented, including unrealistic depths from modeling limitations, DEM sinks, tile boundaries, or DEM issues.
The RP100 depth field and the two matching JRC permanent-water tiles were downloaded. The separate spurious-depth artifact mask was not downloaded, so those artifact flags are unavailable here.
Transparent zero-depth, NoData, and outside-coverage pixels look alike in the map preview; the preview is visual context only and no facility exposure result is derived from it.

Attribution and change indication are required (ODbL 1.0 / CC BY 4.0). Publicly distributed derived databases must comply with ODbL share-alike. The layer must not be described as observed flooding or an official warning.
No verified hospital point layer is currently available. NIHFW coordinates remain review-only because source coordinate order, CRS/datum, and per-record positional accuracy are unspecified.
analysis_status: Licence resolved (ODbL 1.0 applied; CC BY 4.0 also stated). Preview is displayed as modelled scenario context only. Asset-level screening is reported separately and is not an observed exposure estimate.
